                    LIST OF DEFAULT EMISSION FACTORS


1      The Marine Environment Protection Committee (the Committee), at its eighty-first
session, agreed to the establishment of a GESAMP* Working Group on Life Cycle GHG
Intensity of Marine Fuels (GESAMP-LCA WG) to provide scientific and technical assessment
of issues related to the implementation of the IMO Guidelines on life cycle GHG intensity of
marine fuels (LCA Guidelines).

2      The Committee, at its eighty-third session, having approved the Methodology for
submission, scientific review and recommendation of proposed default emission factors by
GESAMP-LCA WG (MEPC.1/Circ.916), invited interested Member States to submit proposals
for default emission factors.

3       Following consideration of the report of the second meeting of GESAMP-LCA WG, the
Committee, at its eighty-fourth session (27 April to 1 May 2026), agreed to an initial default
well-to-tank (WtT) emission factor  for intermediate-crop corn-based ethanol produced with
biomass as an  energy  source  for combined  heat and power (CHP)  (pathway  code:
EtOH_b_FR_intcorn_r_CHP), as set out in the annex to this circular. MEPC 84 further agreed to
incorporate the recommended initial default value into the forthcoming set of amendments to
the 2024 Guidelines on life cycle GHG intensity of marine fuels (2024 LCA Guidelines, resolution
MEPC.391(81)).

4     Member Governments are  invited to bring  this  circular  to the attention  of  all
parties concerned.


                                                   ***





*    GESAMP stands  for IMO/FAO/UNESCO-IOC/WMO/IAEA/UN/UNDP/UN Environment/UNIDO/ISA Joint
      Group of Experts on the Scientific Aspects of Marine Environmental Protection.
